description: This file defines a command-line tool class 'AutoRebaseline' for automating the process of rebaselining tests with 'NeedsRebaseline' expectations in a Chromium/WebKit testing environment. It includes methods for fetching build revisions, parsing test expectations, generating commit messages, managing git branches, and executing rebaseline operations.

classes.name: AutoRebaseline
classes.description: A command class for automating the process of rebaselining tests with 'NeedsRebaseline' expectations, including methods for fetching revisions, parsing test expectations, creating commit messages, managing git branches, and executing rebaseline operations.

methods.name: bot_revision_data
methods.description: Fetches revision data from buildbot for each builder.

methods.name: _strip_comments
methods.description: Removes comments and extra whitespace from a line.

methods.name: tests_to_rebaseline
methods.description: Identifies tests with 'NeedsRebaseline' expectations that need to be rebaselined based on revision criteria.

methods.name: commit_message
methods.description: Generates a commit message for the rebaseline patch.

methods.name: link_to_patch
methods.description: Constructs a URL link to a specific commit.

methods.name: get_test_prefix_list
methods.description: Prepares a list of tests to rebaseline and associated builder info.

methods.name: _run_git_cl_command
methods.description: Runs a git cl command with timeout and logging.

methods.name: tree_status
methods.description: Checks the status of the Chromium tree (open/closed).

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to perform the rebaseline operation, managing branches, parsing tests, and executing git commands.
